title: Automate Google Business Profile posts with GPT-4 & Google Sheets | n8n workflow template

facts.fact: The workflow template is listed on n8n for a purchase price of $25.
The workflow's Schedule Trigger runs daily at 9AM by default, and the page says this is configurable.
The template's last update was 8 months before the page was captured.
The workflow's Google Sheet is expected to mark rows for publishing with a Status that is blank or set to "Unpublished".
facts.quote: Should be blank or "Unpublished" to trigger the flow

facts.fact: Google Business Profile API quota is set to zero by default and must be requested through a Google support form before use.
facts.quote: You need to request for GMB (Google Business Profile) API Quota from here, beacuse by deafult it sets to zero

facts.fact: The template's example OpenAI prompt asks for a short, engaging Google Business Post suitable for a local audience with a subtle call to action.
facts.quote: Write a short, engaging Google Business Post about: "{{ $json.topic }}". Make it suitable for a local audience and include a subtle call to action.

facts.fact: The Google Sheet format for the template uses the columns Topic, Status, Date (optional), and Notes (optional), with Notes not used in automation.
facts.quote: Notes | (Optional) Internal info — not used in the automation

facts.fact: The template's Generate Post Text node uses OpenAI GPT-4 to write a local-business-optimized post.
facts.quote: Uses OpenAI (GPT-4) to write a compelling, local-business optimized post

facts.fact: The template's workflow categories on n8n are Social Media and Multimodal AI.
